tasks.label: crop-sequence2
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $root = 'C:\Users\pande\PortfolioWebsite'; $ffmpeg = Join-Path $root 'node_modules\ffmpeg-static\bin\win32\x64\ffmpeg.exe'; $input = Join-Path $root 'sequence2.mp4'; $temp = Join-Path $root 'sequence2_cropped.mp4'; $backup = Join-Path $root 'sequence2.mp4.bak'; $report = Join-Path $root 'sequence2_crop_report.txt'; try { if (-not (Test-Path $ffmpeg)) { throw "FFmpeg not found: $ffmpeg" }; if (-not (Test-Path $input)) { throw "Input video not found: $input" }; $before = Get-Item $input; & $ffmpeg -y -i $input -vf 'crop=in_w:in_h-100' -c:a copy $temp; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "ffmpeg failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }; if (Test-Path $backup) { Remove-Item $backup -Force }; Move-Item $input $backup; Move-Item $temp $input; $after = Get-Item $input; $bak = Get-Item $backup; @("Status=Success", "BeforeBytes=$($before.Length)", "AfterBytes=$($after.Length)", "BackupBytes=$($bak.Length)", "Output=$input", "Backup=$backup") | Set-Content -Path $report -Encoding ASCII } catch { @("Status=Error", "Message=$($_.Exception.Message)") | Set-Content -Path $report -Encoding ASCII; exit 1 }
